xxxl.$description: Used for button focus state only (Figma note)

sm.$description: dual-purpose: SM canonical viewport; SM band has no CSS lower bound (uses `max-width: 767px`)

md.$description: dual-purpose: MD media-query lower threshold AND canonical viewport

lg.$description: dual-purpose: LG media-query lower threshold AND canonical viewport

xl.$description: dual-purpose: XL media-query lower threshold AND canonical viewport

hover.$description: Same as default — Primary keeps white-on-dark across states

default.$description: Identity colour stays on the keyline + label

hover.$description: Existing tonal overlay per Figma description

default.$description: Label + icon + keyline share this colour (consumer drives `border-color: currentColor`)

border.$description: Mostly invisible on Primary/Tertiary/Inverse/Text (border-width-none); visible on Secondary + both Ghosts

radius.$description: Outer corner radius on every size. LifeLock buttons are pill-shaped

focus.$description: Keyboard focus outline corner. Matches the surface — pill on pill

primary.$description: Used by Primary / Tertiary / Inverse / Text — keyline drawn but invisible so geometry stays constant across types

s.$description: S — FIXED outer height (mirrors Figma auto-layout FIXED behaviour)

size.$description: Minimum inline-size floor. Mirrors Figma's `min-w-[48px]`. Suppressed on `.btn--icon-only` (the icon-only cell pins `inline-size` to its size's `--button-block-size-*` instead)

s.$description: S size — vertical padding (visually clipped by FIXED `--button-block-size-s` = 24 px)

gray.$description: renamed from bare `gray` to disambiguate from `neutral/*` ramp

input.$description: Same primitive as `--color-bg-default`; named separately so a future input-only re-target doesn't ripple into surfaces.

disabled.$description: Subtle gray. Distinct from `--color-disabled-bg` because input disabled is a softer treatment.

default.$description: Alias chain → `color/off-black`. Generic-purpose default body / input-value / label text.

error.$description: Same red as `signal/critical` so error-text reads consistently.

tertiary.$description: Web-ODS gallery-chrome compat; also consumed by `slider.scss` (existing component)

default.$description: Mid-neutral border — visible at rest, recedes against page chrome.

focus.$description: Alias chain → `color/harbor-blue`. Reuses the system-wide focus border.

glow.$description: Composes the 24% alpha glow inline via `color-mix` so the glow auto-tracks any re-target of `--color-border-focus`. No new primitive needed.
Softer red-tint for the error focus-glow.

text.$description: shared across base / CTA / Input — text-on-disabled is consistent

border.$description: shared across base / CTA / Input — border-on-disabled is consistent

bg.$description: system default; CTA and Input extensions intentionally re-target to lighter primitives (`--color-bg-cta-disabled → neutral-10`, `--color-bg-input-disabled → soft-gray`) for per-component visual weight — see design decision 13 below and the CTA / Input extension tables

default.$description: retained for legacy compat; new shadow consumers compose `rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--opacity-N))` inline

primary.$description: Web-ODS gallery-chrome compat; also consumed by `slider.scss` (existing component)

horizontal.$description: each stop binds to a Color primitive where one matches

sm.$description: 360 − 2 × 16; reference content width at SM canonical viewport (band content is fluid)

md.$description: 768 − 2 × 32 = 704; reference content width at MD canonical viewport (band content is fluid)

lg.$description: 1024 − 2 × 44 = 936; reference content width at LG canonical viewport (band content is fluid)

width.$description: canonical container max for templates per `code-conventions.mdc` § 7.3

sm.$description: unit = "columns", not px; consumed by `grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--grid-columns-sm), 1fr)`
`(328 − 3 × 12) / 4 = 73` (rounding leftover; not 4-px-aligned — intentional); reference value at canonical vw, actual track width fluid via 1fr

md.$description: `(704 − 11 × 16) / 12 = 44`; reference value at canonical vw, actual track width fluid via 1fr

lg.$description: `(936 − 11 × 24) / 12 = 56`; reference value at canonical vw, actual track width fluid via 1fr

10.$description: consumed by shadow inline rgba (`rgba(0, 0, 0, var(--opacity-10))`)

hover.$description: Hover elevation. **Intentionally identical to `default`**. Lift comes from element-level Y-translate on the consumer.

pressed.$description: Pressed elevation. Visibly tighter than `default` (smaller Y, smaller blur).

primary.$description: sans-serif; bound by all 23 Primary TextStyles

secondary.$description: serif; bound by all 8 Secondary heading TextStyles

light.$description: available across all roles (heading, body, button, label, tagline, secondary-heading)

extrabold.$description: **button-only** for Primary; available across all 8 Secondary heading roles
